rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: SentinelGate is an MCP proxy that provides deterministic access control for AI agents. Every tool call is intercepted, evaluated against CEL-based policies, and logged before execution. Features include role-based access control, content scanning for PII and secrets, session-aware policies, response transformations, budget and quota management, and comprehensive audit trails. Built with Go, it operates as a single binary with sub-millisecond overhead.
